name: Nolizi Calendar
description: Books meetings through a hosted MCP server and owner-authenticated REST API: list event types, check live availability, create, verify and cancel bookings. Beta.

skills.name: List Event Types
skills.description: Lists the account owner bookable event types and their slugs via the list_event_types tool or GET /api/v1/event-types.

skills.name: Check Availability
skills.description: Returns live open start/end slots for a chosen event type via list_available_slots or GET /api/v1/slots.

skills.name: Create Booking
skills.description: Books a confirmed slot with attendee name, email and timezone via create_booking or POST /api/v1/bookings.

skills.name: List Upcoming Bookings
skills.description: Lists upcoming bookings via list_upcoming_bookings or GET /api/v1/bookings, used to verify a booking receipt.

skills.name: Cancel Booking
skills.description: Cancels an existing booking by its authorized booking ID via cancel_booking or the bookings cancel endpoint.
